patch.summary: Bouncer migration guide: inventory → rehearse → freeze → validate integrations — grounded in researched limitations and catalogue peers.

blocks.body: Migrate to Bouncer by inventorying legacy email-marketing fields, mapping them to Bouncer objects, rehearsing a freeze window, and validating Mailchimp, HubSpot, Activecampaign before reopening writes.
bullets: Inventory → map → rehearse → cut over → reopen
Highest risk: Not an email sending or campaign tool
Success signal: contact management works for the pilot cohort

blocks.heading: Bouncer migration cutover playbook
blocks.body: Migrations fail from optimistic timelines — not from missing motivation.

scenarios.title: Field inventory
scenarios.body: Export legacy fields that power contact management and mark must-map vs archive.

scenarios.title: Rehearsal load
scenarios.body: Run a non-prod load into Bouncer; measure match rates before the freeze.

scenarios.title: Production freeze
scenarios.body: Freeze legacy writes; cut over; validate Mailchimp; then reopen.

steps.label: Migrate when Marketers cleaning lists before campaigns outweigh migration cost
Delay if this limitation hits cutover: Not an email sending or campaign tool
If Bouncer mapping is poor, compare destination fit with InboxAlly before moving data twice

items.title: No freeze window
items.body: Dual-writing without a freeze creates irrevocable duplicates.

items.title: Integrations last
items.body: Wire Mailchimp in rehearsal — not on Monday morning after cutover.

items.title: Data risk 1
items.body: Not an email sending or campaign tool

items.title: Data risk 2
items.body: Core verification is credit-based (not a single flat unlimited plan)

items.title: Data risk 3
items.body: Catch-all / unknown results still require judgment even with deep verification claims

checklist.label: Complete field inventory for contact management
Mitigate: Not an email sending or campaign tool
